newsitem.title: USA: Stocks fall as investors eye wholesale inflation data.
newsitem.headline: Stocks fall as investors eye wholesale inflation data.

text.p: Stock prices closed lower Thursday as investors kept a low profile ahead of Friday's release of the Producer Pricer Index for March.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed down 23.79 points at 6,540.05. In the broader market, declining issues led advances 13-10 on moderate volume of 423 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
